messages.subject: Structural Equation Modeling with R/lavaan
parts:
Hello LAVAAN members

We invite you to explore a powerful framework for analyzing intricate relationships in your data. Structural Equation Modeling in R led by Scott Colwell (University of Guelph and Enablytics) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. Structural equation modeling (SEM) offers a powerful framework for analyzing complex relationships, latent constructs, and measurement error in your data. This seminar provides hands-on training in specifying, estimating, and testing SEM models using the R/lavaan package. By mastering these techniques, you can enhance the rigor of your analyses, interpret nuanced effects, and produce publishable results for your own research projects.

Access this seminar whenever convenient and feel free to circulate this with colleagues and students who may be interested!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
